workDiagnostics.pageDescription: Record-level diagnostics for historical work: missing or conflicting representations, adoption provenance, suspected manual-entry defects and time entry chain assurance.

proposals.appendNotAdopted: Continuations apply only once this organization uses evidence-based append admission.
proposals.continuationDescription: Future entries continue from the chosen existing entry. Nothing is rechained or removed, and history before the anchor keeps its issues.
proposals.description: Conflicts outside evidence-only repair, and histories that cannot be admitted automatically, need an explicit proposal. An administrator approves the exact proposal; applying it re-checks the evidence and stops if anything changed. A continuation only guarantees continuity after its anchor; earlier history stays unverified.
proposals.evidenceRequired: Describe the evidence that establishes the new values.
proposals.failed: The request could not be completed.
proposals.noRepairTargets: No work in this scope has findings an explicit repair could address.
proposals.notAuthorized: Applying proposals has not been authorized for this organization.
proposals.refused: This proposal cannot be made from current evidence: {reasons}
proposals.staleResult: Evidence changed since this proposal was made. Nothing else was written; create a new proposal from current evidence.
proposals.title: Repair and continuation proposals

repair.description: Fills only values that other evidence of the same work establishes uniquely. Identity, stored minutes, metadata, deletions and approval history are kept. Conflicts and gaps without evidence stay held for review.
repair.empty: No historical gap in this scope can be repaired from evidence.
repair.failed: The repair could not be applied.

hold.conflictingEvidence: Other evidence on this work conflicts; needs review
hold.noRestorableEvidence: No evidence establishes the missing value
hold.originalActorUnrepresentable: No entry names who completed the work
hold.originalRuleUnknown: No representation holds the minutes; the original rounding is unknown
hold.referenceOutsideOrganization: A referenced project or category is not this organization's

repair.inactiveDescription: Repair needs separate authorization for this organization. The plan stays readable.
repair.notAuthorized: Repair has not been authorized for this organization.
repair.reasonRequired: Enter the reason for this repair.
repair.stale: Evidence changed since this plan was read. Nothing was written; review the refreshed plan.
repair.title: Historical gap repair

workDiagnostics.title: Work Diagnostics

summary.scopeAll: All employees. Dates cover every time zone's calendar days.
summary.blockingDescription: Missing or conflicting evidence that makes relevant work uncertain.
summary.affectedDescription: Employees whose work in this scope cannot be established.

status.completeDescription: No relevant missing or conflicting evidence, including pending, rejected and open work.
status.widenedOrganization: Ownership could not be established, so the whole organization is uncertain.
status.widenedEmployees: Dates could not be established, so affected employees are uncertain for every period.
status.incompleteDescription: Unaffected data is usable for review, but this scope is not complete.

findings.title: Findings
findings.description: Every finding is read-only evidence. Only the historical gap repair below fills missing values, from evidence and with separate authorization; changing established work needs a separately authorized review.
findings.empty: No missing, conflicting or suspected historical work in this scope.

append.title: Time entry chain assurance
append.description: A separate claim from completeness: lineage and continuity of stored time entries. It does not decide payroll readiness.
append.counts: {verified} of {total} employees have lineage verified from stored evidence.
append.continued: Employees continuing from an approved anchor: {count}. History before each anchor is not verified.

kind.workOutsideOrganizationEmployees: Work owned outside the organization's employees
kind.canonicalLinkShared: Several work periods link one time record
kind.relinkedCanonicalResidue: Time record left behind by relinking
kind.multipleActiveWork: More than one active work period
kind.endpointEntrySuperseded: Work period points to a replaced clock entry
kind.captureInferred: Time zone capture inferred after the event
kind.storedElapsedDiscrepancy: Stored minutes differ from elapsed time
kind.deletedWorkPayable: Deleted work still has a payable time record
kind.approvalRelationshipMissing: Pending work without an approval request
kind.manualZoneUnrecorded: Manual entry time zone not recorded
kind.manualInterpretationAmbiguous: Manual entry time skipped or repeated by a clock change
kind.manualInterpretationMismatch: Manual entry saved at different times than submitted
kind.manualHolidayCheckDatesDiffer: Holiday check used different dates than the work
